title: Topic Coverage Survey
description: A survey measures which topics have records and which are bare, producing a coverage map. The map directs building effort to the barest topics first, where it matters most. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Topic Coverage Survey
demo.program:
# Coverage gap measurement: Topic Coverage Survey
expected = set("62% of target topics".split(";")); have = set("38% of topics bare".split(";"))
gap = sorted(expected - have)
coverage = len(have) / len(expected) * 100
print("measured coverage: %.1f%%" % coverage)
print("gap items:", gap if gap else "none")
print("remediation:", "build bare topics first")
